description: Requirements kept checked after merge: tickets name the requirements they satisfy, and check spec decides over a requirement report.

opinions.summary: A ticket carries a Satisfies: line naming the requirement IDs it changes; an issue that names none is flagged.
Every requirement the ticket names is satisfied in the report; an unsatisfied MUST fails, a SHOULD warns, and a requirement that cannot be measured is a gap.
A MUST that was satisfied on the base branch is still satisfied.
A failing validator means the code or the validator is wrong, never the requirement; a requirement changes only through intake.
